validate: too long for one fact: Under the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation and NEON Systems, the indemnified party may employ separate counsel and participate in the defense, but the fees and expenses of that counsel are not at the indemnifying party's expense if the indemnifying party has assumed the defense with counsel reasonably satisfactory to the indemnified party; the fees are at the indemnifying party's expense if the employment of counsel was specifically authorized in writing by the indemnifying party or the indemnified party was advised by counsel of a conflict of interest or of legal defenses available to the indemnified party that are not available to the indemnifying party, in which case the indemnifying party may not assume the defense, and the indemnifying party is not liable for the reasonable fees of more than one separate firm of attorneys for the indemnified party per action or group of substantially similar related actions in the same jurisdiction, with the firm designated in writing by the indemnified party.
decision_floors.grounded: Under the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation and Neon Systems, Inc., a "Redistributor" means any individual or entity that is granted a license by Neon Systems, Inc. to copy and sublicense one or more Licensed Products to Customers.

Under the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation and Neon Systems, Inc., an "Upgrade" means any revision, adaptation or new version of a Licensed Product which enhances a Licensed Product and which is offered by Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation to registered users of that Licensed Product as an "upgrade."

Under Section 3.2 of the Distributor Agreement as amended, the aggregate outstanding Royalty Advances shall be credited against royalties payable to Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation as and when such royalties are recognized as earned in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.

Under Section 3.2 of the Distributor Agreement as amended, upon expiration or termination of the Distributor Agreement, Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation shall repay to NEON Systems, Inc. the aggregate amount of all outstanding Royalty Advances.

Under the First Amendment to the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation and NEON Systems, Inc., upon exercise of the Option, NEON Systems and Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation or Skunkware shall diligently and in good faith negotiate and execute a definitive purchase and sale agreement for the acquisition of all of the assets of, or outstanding capital stock in, Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation.
decision_floors.attribution: Under the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation and Neon Systems, Inc., a "Redistributor" means any individual or entity that is granted a license by Neon Systems, Inc. to copy and sublicense one or more Licensed Products to Customers.

Under the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation (Licensor) and NEON Systems (Licensee), during the term of the agreement and the five-year period immediately following its termination, the Licensee has the right, at its own expense, to audit and examine the Licensor's records concerning the Licensor's compliance with its confidentiality obligations under the agreement.

Under Section 3.2 of the Distributor Agreement as amended, upon expiration or termination of the Distributor Agreement, Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation shall repay to NEON Systems, Inc. the aggregate amount of all outstanding Royalty Advances.

Under the First Amendment to the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation and NEON Systems, Inc., the definitive purchase and sale agreement shall provide that NEON Systems may pay the purchase price in cash, in shares of its Common Stock, or in some combination thereof.
decision_floors.useful: Under the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation and NEON Systems, a reference in the agreement to an Article, Section, subsection or Exhibit refers to an Article, Section, subsection or Exhibit of the agreement unless otherwise indicated.
